description: A firm per-word rise that declares how long the copy must stay on screen to be read before anything exits.
inspiration: Subtitles and lower thirds: the animation is the easy part; leaving it up long enough is the job.
usage_notes: Hold = x_hold_ms + words × x_hold_per_word_ms, counted from the end of the enter (last word settled), not its start. An agent cycling phrases must not start the exit sooner, even if the surrounding loop is shorter: lengthen the loop instead. 250ms/word is a comfortable reading pace for short display copy; 300+ for body-like lines.
x_intent_notes: Unremarkable on purpose, so the words get read.
